decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window

decisions.message: Kestrel Air update: workers at our ground handling contractor in Orlando and Philadelphia plan a 48-hour strike on Dec 22-23, so some flights may be late or canceled. If you are booked between Dec 14 and Dec 27, you can change or cancel for free in the app now: Dec 21 and Dec 24 still have seats. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat or refund you in full.
decisions.why:
With no action, 9% of customers leave and only 89-92% of week 5-10 revenue is kept.
Free changes in week 7 move 6-9 of 36 customers off Dec 22-23 and keep 94-98% of revenue (+$7-11M).
It costs only $0.2M, cuts switching from 9% to 3-6%, and saves our second action for the next surprise.

decisions.target: Passengers booked on Kestrel flights to or from Orlando or Philadelphia between December 21 and December 27

actions.action: Hotel rooms held for stranded passengers, whatever the cause

decisions.message: Kestrel Air: the ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia on Dec 22-23 is still expected. If it leaves you stranded overnight, we are holding hotel rooms for you, whatever the cause. If your flight is canceled, we will rebook you on the next Kestrel flight with a free seat or refund you in full.
decisions.why:
A night on an airport floor is what people remember from a holiday strike.
Hotels turn a cancellation into an inconvenience.
It costs $0.2M.
